text.p: Winnipeg Commodity Exchange canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0830 CDT.

CANOLA - C$0.50 to C$1.00 lower on CBOT soycomplex calls, follow through from CBOT Project A, cold weather in U.S. growing areas and expectations of continued fund selling. July WCE futures crush margin rose to -2.77 Thursday from -4.21 Wednesday. Canada's dollar was firmer at C$1.3660 versus the U.S. dollar and rose to 84.60 Japanese Yen and rose to 1.2457 German Marks.
FLAXSEED - Steady to C$0.50 down in the July with pressure seen from allied markets.
WESTERN BARLEY - C$0.20 to C$0.50 down on CBOT corn calls with technical support seen in the July at C$136.
FEED WHEAT - Steady to C$0.20 down on CBOT corn, wheat and WCE barley calls.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
